headline: Eshaan Mistry climbs to 72nd on ARC-AGI-2

sections.text: Eshaan Mistry climbed 50 places, from 122nd to 72nd, after gaining 3.61 points to reach 36.39 on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The move takes Mistry into the board’s top 100.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
